newsitem.title: USA: Youth Services sees Q3 shr loss and charge.
newsitem.headline: Youth Services sees Q3 shr loss and charge.

text.p: Youth Services International Inc said Monday it will dispose of its behavioral health line of business and take a one-time restructuring charge of no more than $27 million.
The company said it is dropping the line so it can focus on its core juvenile justice business.
The company said the behavioral health line is not performing to its expectations, and it is working with Equitable Securities Corp to sell the business.
The company said it expects a loss for its third quarter ended March 31 of $2.28 to $2.31 per share as a result of its decision.
The company said it expects the loss in the quarter, before the write-downs, will be $0.03 to $0.06 per share.
The company said its juvenile justice programs have met expectations for the quarter.
The company said it expects a loss of $2.05 to $2.08 per share for the nine months ended March 31. The company estimates the earnings would have been $0.90 to $0.12 per share before the write-downs.
